annotations.text:
What staging serves today.

Fifty rows, seven distinct problems, forty-five of them already resolved. The four pins name what is actually wrong — the count, the grouping, the weight, and the missing answer to "is the agent working".

The reformulated Overview. It ticks: the runs in flight advance and the feed receives, with no reload.

The order of the page is the order of the operator's questions — is the agent working, is anything blocked on me, how is the estate, what keeps happening. The fifty rows are at the bottom, as the seven grouped subjects they are.

Status is direction B. Tweaks above the frame: dark, compact, live off.

The vocabulary the other sections inherit: status, the three list shapes and when each is right, the four live states, the spacing and motion scales — and a section pricing what adopting this costs, because the visual gate holds thirty-six baselines at zero pixels of difference.
The same patterns on a second screen, to show they generalise. Grouped rows, filter chips carrying the address, and resolved declared as a success state.
Click the areas on the left, press Push an event, then press Reload the old way to see the difference. The latency tweak changes how long the region waits.

Four directions for the status chip, judged where it is actually read — in a list, not in a swatch.

B is chosen and applied to every other frame. It is built only from steps the design system already carries, so it costs no token change — the bill is the visual baselines, priced on the patterns sheet.
